description: Utah motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Utah?
What does Utah law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Utah: only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow.

questions.q: In Utah, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Utah issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
